idea-plugin.name: SecureView Password Masking
idea-plugin.description:
SecureView is an IntelliJ Platform plugin that visually masks password and secret values in editor tabs without changing file contents.

Features:

  • Automatically detects common secret key patterns (password, secret, api_key, token, etc.)
  • Supports multiple formats: .properties, YAML, JSON, XML, Java/Kotlin assignments
  • Visual folding that displays as ******** in the editor
  • Does not modify the actual file contents

Important: This is a display aid, not a security boundary. The real values remain accessible to the IDE, file operations, search, clipboard, plugins, and other processes.
